title: Rig view, version 1
description: One rig, as the dashboard draws it. A rig serves this about itself at GET /api/v1/view; a portal serves it about each connected rig at GET /api/v1/rigs/<name>/view, from what the rig reported. The same page reads either. Keys are never removed within a version; a key that changes meaning bumps `contract`.

name.description: The worker name a node reports to its portal; `local` on a farm that is nobody's node.

version.description: The rig software's version as the rig reports it, e.g. 1.0.336.

seen_at.description: ISO 8601. When the rig was last heard from; now, when it is answering for itself.

health.description: The host health snapshot (an object with `status` and its checks), the one-word status alone on a rig lent to the caller, or null when the rig has not reported one.

config.description: The host configuration as the rig reports it; withheld (null) from a caller the rig is only lent to.

setup.description: rig_setup.capabilities: what the rig is set up to do, as rows.
